name: create-project
description: Creates an initial TypeScript Hello World project.

# Command: create-project

Apply the `project-scaffold` skill.

Inspect the existing files before making any changes.

Create or align the following files with the project requirements: `src/hello.ts`, `src/math.ts`, `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `README.md`, and `.gitignore`.

Do not overwrite unrelated user changes.

Verify that running `npm start` after building the project outputs `Hello, World!`.

Report the files created or modified and any checks that were not performed.
